82	### 2.1 Index discipline: pointed covers, arbitrary opens
83	
84	```lean
85	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. -/
86	structure Scheme.PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
87	  opens : X → X.Opens
88	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
89	```
90	
91	with the refinement preorder `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`.
92	
93	Decision rationale (each alternative was weighed):
94	
95	- **Not finite covers, not affine covers, not `Set X.Opens`.** Pointed covers give:
96	  (a) *smallness for free* — the index type is the fixed carrier `X : Type u`, so the sigma type
97	  in §2.3 stays in `Type u`; (b) *canonical refinement maps* — a refinement `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰` refines
98	  **indexwise** (`𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`), so the cocycle-restriction map needs no choice of a
99	  reindexing function and no "independence of the refinement map" lemma at the carrier level;
100	  (c) *directedness by pointwise `⊓`* (`(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x := 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x`), so the
101	  refinement colimit is filtered; (d) *clean pullback* — for `f : X ⟶ Y` the pulled-back cover is
102	  `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens (f x))`, again pointed, again indexed by the carrier. Affineness
103	  constraints would break (d) (preimages of affines are not affine); `Set`-indexing breaks (b)
104	  (pullback collapses indices).
105	- Affine or finite covers re-enter as *cofinality lemmas*, not as carrier structure: every
106	  pointed cover is refined by a pointed affine cover (`x ↦` an affine open neighbourhood inside
107	  `𝒰.opens x`; the choice lives inside a `Prop`, so no data escapes). This is where the
108	  2-cover computations of the χ-ledger and the T₀ engine plug in.
109	
110	### 2.2 The cocycle layer: build on `PresheafOfGroups.H1`
111	
112	**Decision: build on mathlib's fixed-family layer**, not hand-rolled. Instantiation:
113	
114	```lean
115	/-- The units presheaf of a scheme, on its small Zariski site. -/
116	def Scheme.unitsPresheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} :=
117	  X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat ⋙ CommMonCat.units
118	-- (OPEN-4: if the `forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat` path is absent in v4.31, a ~20-line
119	-- bespoke functor replaces the composition; the statement shape is unchanged.)
120	
121	abbrev Scheme.unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) :=
122	  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
123	```
124	
125	Here the site category is the poset `X.Opens`, the family is `𝒰.opens : X → X.Opens`, and
126	mathlib's `OneCochain/OneCocycle/OneCohomologyRelation/IsCohomologous/H1` + `One (H1 G U)`
127	(`Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/NonabelianCohomology/H1.lean:58–197`) come for free. On a poset
128	with infima, the `ev (i j) (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j)`-style cochain is *equivalent* to the
129	classical pair data `g x y ∈ 𝒪ˣ(𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y)` with the cocycle condition on triple infima: homs
130	are subsingletons, so `ev` is determined by its value at `T = 𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y` via `ev_precomp`, and
131	`ev_trans` at the triple infimum is the classical condition. **Binding ergonomic requirement**:
132	`Picard/CechH1.lean` must provide the two-way bridge so lane agents never touch `ev` directly:
133	
134	```lean
135	/-- Build a 1-cocycle over a poset with binary infima from classical pair data. -/
136	def PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.ofPairs
137	    (g : ∀ x y, G.obj (op (𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y)))
138	    (hg : ∀ x y z, /- restrictions to the triple infimum satisfy g x y · g y z = g x z -/) :
139	    OneCocycle G 𝒰.opens
140	lemma ev_inf (γ : OneCocycle G 𝒰.opens) (x y) : γ.ev x y ⋯ = ⋯   -- extraction at the infimum
141	```
142	
143	Additions ours to make (all in `Picard/CechH1.lean`, stated generically over any `Cᵒᵖ ⥤
144	CommGrpCat.{w}` — a mathlib-PR candidate, their file's TODO list asks for exactly this):
145	
146	- `Mul/Inv/CommGroup (OneCocycle Gc U)` when the presheaf is commutative-group-valued (the
147	  product of cocycles satisfies `ev_trans` only using commutativity), and the descended
148	  `CommGroup (H1 Gc U)` via `Quot.map₂` (compatibility of `IsCohomologous` with products again
149	  uses commutativity).
150	- Restriction along an indexwise refinement `res : H1 G 𝒰 →* H1 G 𝒱` for `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰`
151	  (on cocycles: restrict values along the inclusions; strictly functorial:
152	  `res_res : res h₂ ∘ res h₁ = res (h₁.trans h₂)` holds on the nose at cochain level).
153	
154	### 2.3 The refinement colimit
155	
156	```lean
157	/-- The definitional Picard group: Čech H¹ of the units presheaf, colimit over pointed covers. -/
158	def Scheme.CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
159	  Quot (fun p q : (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, PresheafOfGroups.H1 ⋯ 𝒰.opens) =>
160	    ∃ 𝒲, ∃ (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1), res h₁ p.2 = res h₂ q.2)
161	```
162	
163	- The relation is an equivalence *because the poset is directed* (common refinement by pointwise
164	  `⊓`) and `res` strictly composes; the standard filtered-colimit argument is elementary and
165	  choice-free.
166	- Universe accounting: `X.PointedCover : Type u`, each `H1 … : Type u` (index `X : Type u`,
167	  values in `Type u`), the sigma is `Type u`, the quotient is `Type u`. **No `ULift` anywhere.**
168	- `CommGroup (X.CechPic)`: multiplication of classes represented on a common refinement;
169	  well-definedness from §2.2's `CommGroup (H1 …)` + `res` being a group hom.
170	- Constructor/eliminator API: `CechPic.mk (𝒰) (γ : OneCocycle …) : X.CechPic`,
171	  `CechPic.ind`, `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff_of_refines`, and the "sanity gate"
172	  `CechPic (Spec (.of K)) ≃* PUnit`-style triviality for fields (one-point space, one cover,
173	  `ev_refl` kills every cocycle) — this is Lane 1's cheap end-to-end test.
174	
175	### 2.4 Group structure: multiplicative, `CommGrpCat`-valued
176	
177	**Decision: multiplicative.** Justification (each item load-bearing):
178	
179	1. The cocycle values are *units of rings*; their native structure is multiplicative, and
180	   `tensor product of line bundles = pointwise multiplication of transition units`,
181	   `dual = pointwise inverse` — recon lesson 1's entire point. An additive carrier would
182	   re-introduce a translation layer at exactly the spot the old draft burned.
183	2. `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` takes `F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}` — multiplicative — and
184	   `forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` is the canonical bridge. The old draft's
185	   `AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}` choice cost both a universe bump and an additive/multiplicative
186	   mismatch at the representability gate.
187	3. Mathlib's `PresheafOfGroups.H1` layer (§2.2) is multiplicative.
188	
189	The `ℤ`-valued *degree* (§6) is additive; the interface between the multiplicative Pic and the
190	additive degree is a single `→ ℤ` map with `deg (a * b) = deg a + deg b` — pinned as such, no
191	`Multiplicative ℤ` gymnastics in consumer-facing statements.
192	
193	### 2.5 Functoriality: pullback of cocycles
194	
195	```lean
196	def Scheme.CechPic.map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic
197	theorem Scheme.CechPic.map_id (X) : CechPic.map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id _
198	theorem Scheme.CechPic.map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
199	    CechPic.map (f ≫ g) = (CechPic.map f).comp (CechPic.map g)
200	```
201	
202	On representatives: pull the cover back pointwise through `f.base` (`x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`),
203	pull the units back through `f.app`, restrict. `map_comp` compares the covers
204	`(f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰 (g (f x))` and `f ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰 (g (f x)))` — equal opens
205	(`Scheme.preimage_comp`), with the value comparison through `Scheme.Hom.app_comp`; if defeq
206	friction appears, prove it through the refinement relation (both sides restrict to a common
207	refinement) rather than `eqToHom` surgery.
208	
209	### 2.6 Divisor classes as cocycles: the `𝒪(D)` constructor
210	
211	Three constructors, in dependency order. Sign convention (route §3, audited in §8):
212	a local-equation system `(fᵢ)` for an effective `D` produces the class of `𝒪(D)` with
213	transition units `g x y = f x / f y` on overlaps (trivialization of `𝒪(D)` on `𝒰x` by
214	multiplication by `f x`).
215	
216	**(a) Local-equation data → class** (`Picard/DivisorClass.lean`):
217	
218	```lean
219	/-- Local equations for an effective Cartier divisor, adapted to a pointed cover. -/
220	structure Scheme.LocalEquations (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
221	  cover : X.PointedCover
222	  eqn : ∀ x, Γ(X, cover.opens x)
223	  regular : ∀ x, /- eqn x is a nonzerodivisor in every stalk over cover.opens x -/
224	  ratio_isUnit : ∀ x y, IsUnit (/- (eqn x)/(eqn y) as a section on the overlap, i.e.
225	      ∃ u : unit on 𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y, (eqn x)|∩ = u * (eqn y)|∩ -/)
226	
227	def Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass (d : X.LocalEquations) : X.CechPic
228	  -- the class of the cocycle (x,y) ↦ the unit u x y with (eqn x)|∩ = u x y • (eqn y)|∩
229	```
230	
231	with: uniqueness of `u x y` (regularity makes the ratio unit unique — this is why `regular` is
232	part of the data), the cocycle identity for `u` (from associativity of the ratios),
233	*independence*: two `LocalEquations` cutting out the same closed subscheme (or related by
234	unitwise rescaling) have equal `picClass`; *multiplicativity*: pointwise product of equations ↦
235	product of classes; *pullback compatibility*: for `f : X' ⟶ X` such that the pulled-back
236	equations are still regular (guaranteed in the relative situation below),
237	`(d.pullback f).picClass = CechPic.map f d.picClass`.
238	
239	**(b) The two geometric instances** (`Picard/GraphDivisor.lean`):
240	
241	- *Point divisor.* For a `k`-point `P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C`, the image of `P` is an
242	  effective Cartier divisor on `C.left`: the local ring at the image point is a DVR
243	  (`Curve/StalksDVR.lean`, Wave 1), so a uniformizer spreads to a local equation, and away from
244	  the point the equation `1` works. Output: `pointDivisor P : C.left.LocalEquations` (cover:
245	  a distinguished pointed cover; the choice of uniformizer is data *inside* the construction,
246	  with `picClass`-level independence proven — see the choice-discipline note in §4.4).
247	- *Graph divisor.* The diagonal `Δ ⊂ (C ⊗ C).left` is a relative effective divisor over the
248	  **second** factor: `pr₂|Δ` is an isomorphism onto the base, in particular finite flat of rank
249	  1, and smoothness of `C/k` of relative dimension 1 makes the conormal module invertible, so
250	  the ideal of `Δ` is locally one regular equation. Deliverable:
251	
252	  ```lean
253	  def graphLocalEquations (t : T ⟶ C /- in Over (Spec k) -/) :
254	      ((C ⊗ T).left).LocalEquations   -- local equations for Γ_t := (C ◁ t)-pullback of Δ ⋯
255	  theorem graphLocalEquations_base_change ⋯  -- Γ_{t ∘ g} equations = pullback of Γ_t equations
256	  ```
257	
258	  The base-change stability is *by construction*: `Γ_t` is the pullback of the universal `Δ`
259	  along `C ◁ (t ≫ ⋯)`, and (a)'s pullback compatibility applies because `Δ` is a *relative*
260	  divisor over the test factor (fibers never contain a component of `C`), so regularity
261	  survives every base change. Rank certificate: `𝒪_{Γ_t} ≅ 𝒪_T` as `T`-algebras, so the
262	  finite-flat rank of `Γ_t → T` is 1 — the input for the degree of `abelElement` (§6).
263	  This mathematics is Kleiman `ex:DivC` (§3.8: `X₀ = Div¹_{X/S}` for the smooth locus) and
264	  `rmk:Jac` (§5.26: "Given `t : T → X`, its graph subscheme `Γ_t ⊂ X × T` is a relative
265	  effective divisor"); both read.
266	
267	**(c) The meromorphic bridge** (`Picard/MeromorphicTrivialization.lean`; needed by the degree,
268	see §6.1): for `X` *integral*, every `CechPic` class is a divisor class. Cocycle proof shape:
269	every nonempty open contains the generic point; fix a base index `x₀` and localize the cocycle
270	values `g x x₀` into the function field; these are meromorphic local equations for a Cartier
271	divisor whose class is the given one. (Classical statement: Kleiman quotes it in the proof of
272	`th:qpp&p` (§5.4): "Since `X × T` is integral, there is a divisor `D` such that `𝒪(D) = 𝓛`
273	by [Hartshorne, Ex. II 6.15]".) This file also pins `divisorClass` for *differences*
274	`D₁ − D₂` of effective data as `picClass D₁ * (picClass D₂)⁻¹`.

5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle
6	
7	/-!
8	# The definitional Picard group: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf
9	
10	For a scheme `X`, this file defines the Picard group of record of this development:
11	the Čech cohomology `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` on the small Zariski site, computed on **pointed
12	covers** (one open per point of `X`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle`) and
13	stabilized along the refinement preorder.
14	
15	## Main declarations
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic`: the Picard group `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` as the quotient
18	  of `Σ 𝒰, X.unitsH1 𝒰` by agreement on a common refinement, with its `CommGroup`
19	  structure and the constructor/eliminator API `CechPic.mk`, `CechPic.ind`,
20	  `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff`, `CechPic.mk_unitsRes`, `CechPic.mk_mul_mk_inf`.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.map`: contravariant functoriality — for
22	  `f : X ⟶ Y` the pullback `Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic` — with the strict functor laws
23	  `CechPic.map_id` and `CechPic.map_comp` (the lane keystone).
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.subsingleton_of_subsingleton`: on a scheme with a
25	  subsingleton underlying space (e.g. `Spec` of a field) the Picard group is trivial.
26	-/
27	
28	set_option autoImplicit false
29	
30	universe u
31	
32	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
33	
34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
35	
36	namespace Scheme
37	
38	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
39	
40	/-! ## The Picard group  -/
41	
42	instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
43	  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
44	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
45	  iseqv := by
46	    constructor
47	    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
48	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
49	      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
50	    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
51	      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
52	      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
53	      have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
54	      simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
55	      exact e₁'.trans e₂'
56	
57	/-- The definitional Picard group of a scheme: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf,
58	stabilized along refinement of pointed covers. -/
59	def CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
60	  Quotient (cechPicSetoid X)
61	
62	namespace CechPic
63	
64	/-- The Picard class of a unit Čech `H¹` class on a pointed cover. -/
65	def mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : X.CechPic :=
66	  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧
67	
68	@[elab_as_elim]
69	theorem ind {motive : X.CechPic → Prop}
70	    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
71	    motive x :=
72	  Quotient.ind (fun p ↦ by obtain ⟨𝒰, a⟩ := p; exact mk 𝒰 a) x
73	
74	theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} {a : X.unitsH1 𝒰} {b : X.unitsH1 𝒱} :
75	    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔
76	      ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱),
77	        unitsRes h₁ a = unitsRes h₂ b :=
78	  Quotient.eq
79	
80	/-- Two classes agreeing after restriction to a common refinement are equal; in
81	particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/
82	@[simp]
83	theorem mk_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
84	    mk 𝒱 (unitsRes h a) = mk 𝒰 a :=
85	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒱, le_rfl, h, unitsRes_rfl _⟩
86	
87	private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
88	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
89	  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩
90	
91	private lemma mulSig_assoc {𝒰 𝒱 𝒳 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱)
92	    (c : X.unitsH1 𝒳) :
93	    mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳)
94	        (unitsRes inf_le_left (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) *
95	          unitsRes inf_le_right c)
96	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳))
97	        (unitsRes inf_le_left a *
98	          unitsRes inf_le_right (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right c)) := by
99	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳, le_rfl, (inf_assoc 𝒰 𝒱 𝒳).le, ?_⟩
100	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
101	  exact mul_assoc _ _ _
102	
103	private lemma mulSig_compat {p p' q q' : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰}
104	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') : mulSig p q ≈ mulSig p' q' := by
105	  obtain ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ := hp
106	  obtain ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩ := hq
107	  have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
108	  have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
109	  simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
110	  refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_inf h₁ h₃, inf_le_inf h₂ h₄, ?_⟩
111	  show unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₁ h₃) (unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2)
112	      = unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₂ h₄) (unitsRes inf_le_left p'.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q'.2)
113	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes]
114	  rw [e₁', e₂']
115	
116	instance : CommGroup X.CechPic where
117	  mul := Quotient.map₂ mulSig (fun _ _ hp _ _ hq ↦ mulSig_compat hp hq)
118	  one := mk ⊤ 1
119	  inv := Quotient.map (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2⁻¹⟩) (by
120	    rintro p p' ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
121	    exact ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, by simp only [map_inv, e]⟩)
122	  mul_assoc a b c := by
123	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
124	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
125	    induction c using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒳 c =>
126	    exact mulSig_assoc a b c
127	  one_mul a := by
128	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
129	    show mk (⊤ ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤) * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
130	      = mk 𝒰 a
131	    rw [map_one, one_mul, mk_unitsRes]
132	  mul_one a := by
133	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
134	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ ⊤) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤))
135	      = mk 𝒰 a
136	    rw [map_one, mul_one, mk_unitsRes]
137	  inv_mul_cancel a := by
138	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
139	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left a⁻¹ * unitsRes inf_le_right a) = mk ⊤ 1
140	    have h : unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a⁻¹
141	        * unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a = 1 := by
142	      rw [map_inv]
143	      exact inv_mul_cancel _
144	    rw [h]
145	    exact Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
146	  mul_comm a b := by
147	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
148	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
149	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b)
150	      = mk (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
151	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, le_rfl, le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left, ?_⟩
152	    simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
153	    exact mul_comm _ _

155	lemma one_def : (1 : X.CechPic) = mk ⊤ 1 :=
156	  rfl

158	/-- Multiplication of Picard classes on representatives: restrict both to the common
159	refinement `𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱` and multiply there. Holds by definition. -/
160	lemma mk_mul_mk_inf {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱) :
161	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒱 b
162	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) :=
163	  rfl

165	@[simp]
166	lemma mk_one (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : mk 𝒰 (1 : X.unitsH1 𝒰) = 1 :=
167	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩

169	@[simp]
170	lemma mk_mul_mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a b : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
171	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒰 b = mk 𝒰 (a * b) := by
172	  rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
173	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, inf_le_left, ?_⟩
174	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_rfl]
175	
176	@[simp]
177	lemma mk_inv (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : (mk 𝒰 a)⁻¹ = mk 𝒰 a⁻¹ :=
178	  rfl

180	/-! ## Functoriality: pullback of Picard classes -/
181	
182	private def mapSig (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
183	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
184	  ⟨p.1.pullback f, f.pullbackUnitsH1 p.1 p.2⟩
185	
186	private lemma mapSig_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) :
187	    ∀ {p q : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰}, p ≈ q → mapSig f p ≈ mapSig f q := by
188	  rintro ⟨𝒰, a⟩ ⟨𝒱, b⟩ ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
189	  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁,
190	    PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂, ?_⟩
191	  show unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
192	      = unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
193	  rw [Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₁ a, Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₂ b, e]
194	
195	/-- Contravariant functoriality of the Čech Picard group: pull the cover back pointwise,
196	pull the unit cocycles back through `f`, restrict. -/
197	def map (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic where
198	  toFun := Quotient.map (mapSig f) fun _ _ h ↦ mapSig_compat f h
199	  map_one' := by
200	    show mk ((⊤ : Y.PointedCover).pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 ⊤ 1) = 1
201	    rw [map_one, mk_one]
202	  map_mul' a b := by
203	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
204	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
205	    show mk ((𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f)
206	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b))
207	      = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) *
208	          mk (𝒱.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
209	    rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
210	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f, le_rfl,
211	      le_inf (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_left)
212	        (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_right), ?_⟩
213	    simp only [map_mul, ← Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
214	
215	@[simp]
216	lemma map_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
217	    map f (mk 𝒰 a) = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) :=
218	  rfl
219	
220	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along the identity is the identity. -/
221	@[simp]
222	theorem map_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id X.CechPic := by
223	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
224	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
225	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X)) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) = mk 𝒰 a
226	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X) ≤ 𝒰 := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
227	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
228	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
229	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
230	  ext x y T a b
231	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
232	    γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
233	  exact id_unitsAppLE _ _
234	
235	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along a composite (the lane keystone). -/
236	theorem map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : map (f ≫ g) = (map f).comp (map g) := by
237	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
238	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
239	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g)) ((f ≫ g).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
240	    = mk ((𝒰.pullback g).pullback f)
241	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰.pullback g) (g.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a))
242	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g) ≤ (𝒰.pullback g).pullback f := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
243	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
244	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
245	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
246	  ext x y T a b
247	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
248	    Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
249	  rfl

251	/-! ## Sanity gate: triviality over a field -/
252	
253	/-- On a scheme with a subsingleton underlying space — e.g. `Spec` of a field — the
254	Čech Picard group is trivial: every pointed cover is a cover by a single open, on which
255	every unit cocycle is a coboundary. -/
256	instance subsingleton_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] :
257	    Subsingleton X.CechPic := by
258	  refine ⟨fun p q ↦ ?_⟩
259	  induction p using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
260	  induction q using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
261	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩
262	  have := H1.subsingleton_of_forall_le (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
263	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens (fun i j ↦ le_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim i j)))
264	  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
265	
266	/-- The Čech Picard group of the spectrum of a field is trivial. -/
267	theorem eq_one_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] (x : X.CechPic) :
268	    x = 1 :=
269	  Subsingleton.elim x 1
270	
271	example {K : Type u} [Field K] (x : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).CechPic) : x = 1 :=
272	  eq_one_of_subsingleton _ x

87	/-! ## Pointed covers -/
88	
89	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. Pointed covers
90	are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
91	everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
92	refinement order directed. -/
93	structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
94	  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
95	  opens : X → X.Opens
96	  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
97	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
98	
99	namespace PointedCover
100	
101	@[ext]
102	lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
103	  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
104	  simpa using funext h
105	
106	instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
107	  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
108	  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
109	  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
110	  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
111	  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
112	    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
113	      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
114	  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
115	  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
116	  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
117	
118	instance : OrderTop X.PointedCover where
119	  top := { opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤, mem_opens := fun _ ↦ trivial }
120	  le_top _ _ := le_top
121	
122	lemma le_def {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x :=
123	  Iff.rfl
124	
125	@[simp]
126	lemma inf_opens (𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover) (x : X) :
127	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x = 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x :=
128	  rfl
129	
130	@[simp]
131	lemma top_opens (x : X) : (⊤ : X.PointedCover).opens x = ⊤ :=
132	  rfl

134	/-- The pullback of a pointed cover along a morphism of schemes: the pointed cover by
135	preimages, `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`. -/
136	def pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) : X.PointedCover where
137	  opens x := f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x)
138	  mem_opens x := 𝒰.mem_opens (f.base x)
139	
140	@[simp]
141	lemma pullback_opens (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (x : X) :
142	    (𝒰.pullback f).opens x = f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x) :=
143	  rfl

145	lemma pullback_mono (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) :
146	    𝒱.pullback f ≤ 𝒰.pullback f :=
147	  fun x ↦ ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE (h (f.base x)))).le
148

151	/-! ## Unit cocycles on a pointed cover and their restriction -/
152	
153	/-- The unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
154	abbrev unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
155	  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
156	
157	/-- The unit-valued Čech `H¹` of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
158	abbrev unitsH1 (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
159	  PresheafOfGroups.H1 (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens

161	/-- Restriction of unit Čech classes along a refinement of pointed covers, as a group
162	homomorphism. -/
163	def unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) : X.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 𝒱 :=
164	  H1.resHom fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)
165	
166	/-- Restriction along refinements of pointed covers is strictly functorial. -/
167	@[simp]
168	lemma unitsRes_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 : X.PointedCover} (h₁ : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱)
169	    (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : unitsRes h₂ (unitsRes h₁ a) = unitsRes (h₂.trans h₁) a :=
170	  H1.res_res _ _ a
171	
172	@[simp]
173	lemma unitsRes_rfl {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} {h : 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
174	    unitsRes h a = a :=
175	  H1.res_id a
176	/-- If `U` is contained in the preimages of two opens, it is contained in the preimage
177	of their intersection. -/
178	lemma Hom.le_preimage_inf (f : X.Hom Y) {U : X.Opens} {V₁ V₂ : Y.Opens}
179	    (h₁ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₁) (h₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₂) : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V₁ ⊓ V₂) :=
180	  fun _ hx ↦ ⟨h₁ hx, h₂ hx⟩
181	
182	/-- The pair value `γ.evInf i j` of a unit Čech cocycle, retyped as a unit section in
183	`Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ` (definitionally equal). Statements phrased through
184	`unitsEvInf` are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising from the
185	`OneCochain` field types are closed against them by `exact` (definitional bridging). -/
186	def unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
187	    Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ :=
188	  γ.evInf i j
189	
190	/-- Restriction of a unit section along `W ≤ U`, as a group homomorphism between the
191	honest `Γ`-typed unit groups (definitionally the units-presheaf restriction map). -/
192	abbrev unitsRestrict (X : Scheme.{u}) {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :
193	    Γ(X, U)ˣ →* Γ(X, W)ˣ :=
194	  Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
195	
196	@[simp]
197	lemma one_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (i j : X) :
198	    unitsEvInf (1 : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) i j = 1 :=
199	  rfl
200	
201	@[simp]
202	lemma mul_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ₁ γ₂ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
203	    unitsEvInf (γ₁ * γ₂) i j = unitsEvInf γ₁ i j * unitsEvInf γ₂ i j :=
204	  rfl

206	/-- The cocycle identity for the pair values, in unit-section language. -/
207	lemma unitsEvInf_trans {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : X) :
208	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
209	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)
210	        (unitsEvInf γ i j)
211	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
212	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
213	          (unitsEvInf γ j k)
214	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
215	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
216	          (unitsEvInf γ i k) :=
217	  γ.evInf_trans i j k
218	
219	/-- Restriction along a refinement, at the level of pair values. -/
220	lemma res_unitsEvInf {𝒲 𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (hle : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
221	    (i j : X) :
222	    unitsEvInf (γ.res fun k ↦ homOfLE (hle k)) i j
223	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hle i) (hle j)) (unitsEvInf γ i j) :=
224	  γ.res_evInf _ i j

289	/-- The coboundary relation in classical pair form: two 1-cocycles over a poset with
290	binary infima are cohomologous iff there are sections `α i` on the `U i` conjugating the
291	pair values into each other. -/
292	lemma isCohomologous_iff_evInf (γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle G U) :
293	    γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂ ↔ ∃ α : ZeroCochain G U, ∀ i j,
294	      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)).op (α i) * γ₁.evInf i j =

296	  constructor
297	  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
298	    exact ⟨α, fun i j ↦ hα i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)⟩
299	  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
300	    refine ⟨α, fun i j T a b ↦ ?_⟩
301	    have h' := congrArg (G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le : T ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op ·) (hα i j)
302	    simp only [map_mul, map_map] at h'
303	    rw [γ₁.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf i j a b, γ₂.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf i j a b]
304	    exact h'

306	end OneCocycle

311	theorem H1.subsingleton_of_forall_le (G : Pᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) (U : I → P)

313	  have key : ∀ γ : OneCocycle G U, (1 : OneCocycle G U).IsCohomologous γ := by
314	    intro γ
315	    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty I with
316	    | inl hI => exact ⟨1, fun i ↦ isEmptyElim i⟩
317	    | inr hI =>
318	      obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := hI
319	      refine ⟨fun i ↦ γ.ev i i₀ (𝟙 (U i)) (homOfLE (h i i₀)), fun i j T a b ↦ ?_⟩
320	      dsimp only
321	      rw [OneCocycle.one_toOneCochain, OneCochain.one_ev, mul_one,
322	        OneCochain.ev_precomp, OneCochain.ev_precomp, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id,
323	        γ.ev_trans i j i₀ a b (b ≫ homOfLE (h j i₀)),
324	        Subsingleton.elim (a ≫ homOfLE (h i i₀)) (b ≫ homOfLE (h j i₀))]
325	  refine ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩
326	  induction x using Quot.ind with
327	  | _ γ =>
328	    induction y using Quot.ind with
329	    | _ δ =>
330	      exact Quot.sound ((OneCocycle.equivalence_isCohomologous G U).trans
331	        ((OneCocycle.equivalence_isCohomologous G U).symm (key γ)) (key δ))
332	
333	end Poset

342	    (x y : ((G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).obj X)) : x * y = y * x := by
343	  letI : CommGroup ((G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).obj X) := (G.obj X).str

349	  letI : CommGroup ((G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).obj X) := (G.obj X).str

354	/-- The product of two 1-cocycles valued in commutative groups (the cocycle condition

356	protected def mul (γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U) :

365	    OneCocycle (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U where
366	  toOneCochain := γ.toOneCochain⁻¹
367	  ev_trans i j k T a b c := by
368	    simp only [OneCochain.inv_ev]
369	    rw [← mul_inv_rev, val_mul_comm, γ.ev_trans i j k a b c]

372	  mul := OneCocycle.mul

389	  rfl

399	  rfl

403	lemma OneCohomologyRelation.mul
404	    {γ₁ γ₂ δ₁ δ₂ : OneCochain (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U}
405	    {α β : ZeroCochain (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U}

407	    OneCohomologyRelation (γ₁ * δ₁) (γ₂ * δ₂) (α * β) := by
408	  intro i j T a b

410	  rw [val_mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ (γ₁.ev i j a b), h i j a b, h' i j a b,

412	
413	lemma OneCohomologyRelation.inv {γ₁ γ₂ : OneCochain (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U}
414	    {α : ZeroCochain (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U}
415	    (h : OneCohomologyRelation γ₁ γ₂ α) :
416	    OneCohomologyRelation γ₁⁻¹ γ₂⁻¹ α⁻¹ := by
417	  intro i j T a b
418	  simp only [OneCochain.inv_ev, Cochain₀.inv_apply, map_inv]
419	  rw [← mul_inv_rev, ← mul_inv_rev,
420	    val_mul_comm (γ₁.ev i j a b) ((G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).map a.op (α i)),
421	    h i j a b,
422	    val_mul_comm (γ₂.ev i j a b) ((G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).map b.op (α j))]

428	    (γ₁ * δ₁).IsCohomologous (γ₂ * δ₂) := by
429	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := h
430	  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := h'

5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle
6	
7	/-!
8	# The definitional Picard group: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf
9	
10	For a scheme `X`, this file defines the Picard group of record of this development:
11	the Čech cohomology `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` on the small Zariski site, computed on **pointed
12	covers** (one open per point of `X`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle`) and
13	stabilized along the refinement preorder.
14	
15	## Main declarations
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic`: the Picard group `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` as the quotient
18	  of `Σ 𝒰, X.unitsH1 𝒰` by agreement on a common refinement, with its `CommGroup`
19	  structure and the constructor/eliminator API `CechPic.mk`, `CechPic.ind`,
20	  `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff`, `CechPic.mk_unitsRes`, `CechPic.mk_mul_mk_inf`.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.map`: contravariant functoriality — for
22	  `f : X ⟶ Y` the pullback `Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic` — with the strict functor laws
23	  `CechPic.map_id` and `CechPic.map_comp` (the lane keystone).
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.subsingleton_of_subsingleton`: on a scheme with a
25	  subsingleton underlying space (e.g. `Spec` of a field) the Picard group is trivial.
26	-/
27	
28	set_option autoImplicit false
29	
30	universe u
31	
32	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
33	
34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
35	
36	namespace Scheme
37	
38	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
39	
40	/-! ## The Picard group  -/
41	
42	instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
43	  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
44	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
45	  iseqv := by
46	    constructor
47	    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
48	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
49	      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
50	    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
51	      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
52	      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
53	      have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
54	      simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
55	      exact e₁'.trans e₂'
56	
57	/-- The definitional Picard group of a scheme: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf,
58	stabilized along refinement of pointed covers. -/
59	def CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
60	  Quotient (cechPicSetoid X)
61	
62	namespace CechPic
63	
64	/-- The Picard class of a unit Čech `H¹` class on a pointed cover. -/
65	def mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : X.CechPic :=
66	  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧
67	
68	@[elab_as_elim]
69	theorem ind {motive : X.CechPic → Prop}
70	    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
71	    motive x :=
72	  Quotient.ind (fun p ↦ by obtain ⟨𝒰, a⟩ := p; exact mk 𝒰 a) x
73	
74	theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} {a : X.unitsH1 𝒰} {b : X.unitsH1 𝒱} :
75	    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔
76	      ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱),
77	        unitsRes h₁ a = unitsRes h₂ b :=
78	  Quotient.eq
79	
80	/-- Two classes agreeing after restriction to a common refinement are equal; in
81	particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/
82	@[simp]
83	theorem mk_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
84	    mk 𝒱 (unitsRes h a) = mk 𝒰 a :=
85	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒱, le_rfl, h, unitsRes_rfl _⟩
86	
87	private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
88	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
89	  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩
90	
91	private lemma mulSig_assoc {𝒰 𝒱 𝒳 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱)
92	    (c : X.unitsH1 𝒳) :
93	    mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳)
94	        (unitsRes inf_le_left (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) *
95	          unitsRes inf_le_right c)
96	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳))
97	        (unitsRes inf_le_left a *
98	          unitsRes inf_le_right (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right c)) := by
99	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳, le_rfl, (inf_assoc 𝒰 𝒱 𝒳).le, ?_⟩
100	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
101	  exact mul_assoc _ _ _
102	
103	private lemma mulSig_compat {p p' q q' : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰}
104	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') : mulSig p q ≈ mulSig p' q' := by
105	  obtain ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ := hp
106	  obtain ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩ := hq
107	  have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
108	  have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
109	  simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
110	  refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_inf h₁ h₃, inf_le_inf h₂ h₄, ?_⟩
111	  show unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₁ h₃) (unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2)
112	      = unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₂ h₄) (unitsRes inf_le_left p'.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q'.2)
113	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes]
114	  rw [e₁', e₂']
115	
116	instance : CommGroup X.CechPic where
117	  mul := Quotient.map₂ mulSig (fun _ _ hp _ _ hq ↦ mulSig_compat hp hq)
118	  one := mk ⊤ 1
119	  inv := Quotient.map (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2⁻¹⟩) (by
120	    rintro p p' ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
121	    exact ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, by simp only [map_inv, e]⟩)
122	  mul_assoc a b c := by
123	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
124	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
125	    induction c using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒳 c =>
126	    exact mulSig_assoc a b c
127	  one_mul a := by
128	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
129	    show mk (⊤ ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤) * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
130	      = mk 𝒰 a
131	    rw [map_one, one_mul, mk_unitsRes]
132	  mul_one a := by
133	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
134	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ ⊤) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤))
135	      = mk 𝒰 a
136	    rw [map_one, mul_one, mk_unitsRes]
137	  inv_mul_cancel a := by
138	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
139	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left a⁻¹ * unitsRes inf_le_right a) = mk ⊤ 1
140	    have h : unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a⁻¹
141	        * unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a = 1 := by
142	      rw [map_inv]
143	      exact inv_mul_cancel _
144	    rw [h]
145	    exact Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
146	  mul_comm a b := by
147	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
148	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>

201	    rw [map_one, mk_one]

204	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>

221	@[simp]

223	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
224	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
225	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X)) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) = mk 𝒰 a

229	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_

236	theorem map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : map (f ≫ g) = (map f).comp (map g) := by
237	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
238	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
239	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g)) ((f ≫ g).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
240	    = mk ((𝒰.pullback g).pullback f)
241	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰.pullback g) (g.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a))
242	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g) ≤ (𝒰.pullback g).pullback f := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
243	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
244	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
245	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
246	  ext x y T a b
247	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
248	    Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
249	  rfl

252	
253	/-- On a scheme with a subsingleton underlying space — e.g. `Spec` of a field — the
254	Čech Picard group is trivial: every pointed cover is a cover by a single open, on which
255	every unit cocycle is a coboundary. -/
256	instance subsingleton_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] :
257	    Subsingleton X.CechPic := by
258	  refine ⟨fun p q ↦ ?_⟩
259	  induction p using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
260	  induction q using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
261	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩

263	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens (fun i j ↦ le_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim i j)))

267	theorem eq_one_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] (x : X.CechPic) :
268	    x = 1 :=
269	  Subsingleton.elim x 1

272	  eq_one_of_subsingleton _ x

11	the Čech cohomology `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` on the small Zariski site, computed on **pointed
12	covers** (one open per point of `X`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle`) and

18	  of `Σ 𝒰, X.unitsH1 𝒰` by agreement on a common refinement, with its `CommGroup`

25	  subsingleton underlying space (e.g. `Spec` of a field) the Picard group is trivial.

44	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2

48	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
